title: Ryzen 5 7600 Box without a cooler in the build: rule 11 pass (cooler named by AMD)
why: The maker table (src/engine/data/cpuBox.ts, amd.com "Thermal Solution (PIB)") says the Box 7600 comes with an AMD Wraith Stealth; the finding is stated and names it. The plan named the 8600G, but cpuBox.ts has no 8600G row (task 3), so a real 8600G Box is still "not stated" (warning).
